parsedVerdict.reasoning: Most of AppointmentsController does presentation work. It accepts form data, converts it (string to Date), delegates to business services and shapes the response with the presenter. One part does not fit. `book()` enforces a domain scheduling policy: a visit must last between 10 and 120 minutes, and a booking outside that range is rejected with the domain error SchedulingError('rejected'). That is not input-shape validation such as checking that a value is a number. It is a business rule about how long a visit may be, so it belongs in the business (domain) layer, for example in SchedulingService.book or in the Appointment entity. Because the rule lives only in this controller, any other entry point that calls SchedulingService.book skips it. The other methods (`cancel`, `addNote`) only delegate and shape output, which is proper presentation work.
